testcase.name: 来源、提取、判断、评分与人工确认分层，10/10不会写成原文零遗漏
保留两项旧关键风险，不因本轮未检测或隐藏分数而消失
矩阵将检查失败与成功后的无法判断分开，不给失败项假满足
事实未知和布尔否不替换成0，空事实库不加首次评审前置
批量规则只提交明确勾选的pending项，不覆盖驳回和暂缓
单条决定对象已变化时保留输入并禁止旧解释配新ETag提交
显式历史轮次优先，不拿current指针替换所指review
读取刷新失败保留已知记录并显式标明未更新，不伪造空成功
矩阵默认将否决和强制要求置前，不因原始返回顺序让一般评分项遮住核心失败
keeps an unread or failed package directory unknown, with no false empty-project instruction
does not confuse an empty first page with no packages and selects only the explicit later-page revision
keeps malformed later-page pagination unresolved rather than declaring the directory empty
offers package creation only after a valid complete empty directory
rejects an incomplete URL before issuing any package request
restores only the exact package revision and inventory from a link, without creating anything or reading a head as substitute
does not fall back to a directory head when the exact package is missing
does not fall back to a directory head when the exact package is foreign
does not fall back to a directory head when the exact package is digest
rejects a hash-valid inventory for another revision without selecting the current inventory
server actions only, cancel sends nothing, reason required, double submit records once
412 retains reason, never rebases automatically, explicit refresh requires choosing again
lost ACK survives remount with exact original request; another member cannot recover it
archive blockers and submitted-only end follow authoritative capabilities
late old project acknowledgement cannot update the new project
foreign view and tampered stored target fail closed
announces success only after the shared refresh settles and still rejects a later stale reopen intent
all callers awaiting an existing reload wait for its snapshot without another GET
